component.name: M3U TV
component.summary: Live TV, movies and series player for M3U Editor

description.p: M3U TV is the player for M3U Editor and Xtream-compatible servers. Browse live channels with a full program guide, watch movies and series, and pick up where you left off.
Playback uses mpv, with subtitles, multiple audio tracks and hardware video decoding on supported systems.
